question: Who was the Viceroy of India when the Indian National Congress was founded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Dufferin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Lord Dufferin**
 
• Lord Dufferin was Viceroy of India from 1884 - 1888.
 
• Important events during his viceroyalty include:
 
 
• 3rd Burmese War, 1885 - In this war upper and lower Burma were annexed.
 
• Establishment of Indian National Congress in 1885.
